name: session-research
label: Session Research
description: Search and read past session conversations within the current project. Find which session worked on a topic, read its messages, get summaries.

search.description: Full-text search across the calling session's own project (its cwd and user profile). Returns ranked results with rich snippets (400 chars of matching content). This is NOT a cross-project search — for that, see the hints move's search op.

profile.description: Filter to a specific agent profile

role.description: Filter by message sender — 'user' for user messages only, 'assistant' for assistant messages only. Omit to search all.

dateAfter.description: Only sessions active after this date (ISO string, e.g. '2026-04-01')

dateBefore.description: Only sessions active before this date (ISO string, e.g. '2026-04-05')

list.description: List recent sessions, optionally filtered by profile.

profile.description: Filter to a specific agent profile

read.description: Read the conversation messages from a specific session. Returns user/assistant turns with up to 3000 chars per turn (adjustable via maxLength).

offset.description: Skip this many turns from the start (default 0)

role.description: Filter to only user or only assistant turns. Omit to return all turns.

maxLength.description: Max chars per turn (default 3000, max 8000). Use higher values when searching for long-form content.

scan.description: Bulk-preview multiple sessions at once. Shows first 3 turns from each session. Use this after search to quickly check multiple candidates instead of reading each one individually.

sessionIds.description: List of session IDs to scan (max 20)

role.description: Filter to only user or only assistant turns.

info.description: Get metadata for a specific session (profile, model, cost, status, timestamps, tags).
